items.t: Sony shares rise as Playstation dominates GTA VI sales
items.sum: Investing.com-- Sony Corp (TYO:6758) shares rose on Thursday as data showed Playstation covered roughly three quarters of Grand Theft Auto VI sales, the long-awaited open-world crime videogame from Take-Two Interactive (NASDAQ:TTWO).
